search.text: Filters the list by what you type: the character name, the account name, the citizen ID or the job. For a session number put # in front, like #5.

filter.needHelp: Shows the dead and anyone whose hunger or thirst is under 20. Start with them if you want to help people.
filter.staff: Shows only people with staff levels: mod, admin and god.
filter.frozen: Shows the players frozen right now. Remember to unfreeze them when you are done.

players.columns: Chooses how many columns you see. It changes your view only; nothing changes for the players.
players.modeEssential: Shows only what matters: citizen ID, name, job, status, hunger, thirst, ping and distance.
players.modeDetail: Adds more columns: cash, gold, health, stamina, gang and level.

col.citizenId: The character's fixed citizen ID, with the session number (#) beside it, which changes on every join. Use the citizen ID in commands and forms.
col.name: The name of the character they play, with their RedM account name under it.
col.job: The character's job and grade. 'On duty' means they are working it right now.
col.status: Their state now: Well, Low needs when hunger or thirst is under 20, Dead, or Frozen when staff are holding them in place.

hunger.text: What is left of the hunger bar, out of 100. Under 20 the bar turns red: the player needs to eat.

thirst.text: What is left of the thirst bar, out of 100. Under 20 the bar turns red: the player needs to drink.

ping.text: How fast the player's connection to the server is, in milliseconds. Lower is better; above 150 they notice lag.

col.distance: How far they are from you in the world, in metres or kilometres. Handy to see who is near you.
col.cash: The cash they carry now, in dollars.
col.gold: The gold they carry now. It can have decimals, like 4.25.
col.health: Their health out of 100. Zero means dead or down.
col.stamina: Stamina out of 100: their energy for running and fighting. It drops with effort and comes back with rest.
col.gang: The gang they belong to and their rank in it, if they have one.
col.group: Their staff level: regular player, mod, admin or god. Staff ranks are managed on the Ranks page, linked from the Moderation section of their file.

players.openCharacter: Opens this ID on the Characters page, where you can see their data and change their money and job even while they are offline.
players.clearFilter: Clears the search and the filter and puts every player back in the list.

players.search: Search by name, citizen ID or #session…
players.emptyFilter: No player matches this search or filter.
players.emptyOffline: Citizen ID %s is not online right now.
